name: mug_beside_pod_grasp
hypothesis: A mug immediately in front of the pod dish occupies clearance needed by the hand during the taught approach. The position-controlled approach can strike the mug before the fingers surround the tablet.
expected_failure: Step 3 pushes or topples the mug, produces an unplanned arm contact, or stops because the pod was not lifted.
real_world_story: Someone leaves a coffee mug beside the detergent dish after breakfast.
